book.name: 1 Abhakoriinto
book.title: Enyaarubha yo okutaanga ya Pauro ku Bhakoriinto

content: Emisororo gyo okubhasakirya abhiikirirya
Bhoono, niragaamba iguru ye emisororo gyo okubhasakirya abhahoreeru bha mumugye gwa Yerusaremu. Emwe kweeki mukore kyeego niabhabhuuriiri abhaatu bha mumakanisa ge ekyaaro kya Garatia.
Eziisiku zyoosi zyo okutaanga zyo obhutuuro, omuutu wowoosi gati weenyu abhe aratuura ehata kuriingʼaana no okubhona kwaaye, okubha eriibhaga hano nikuuza kweemwe, mubhe mumariri kukumania omusororo.
Hano niraaze, nirabhatuma ne eziinyaarubha zyo okumenyeekererya abhaatu bhano mubhasoriri okubha bhahire emisororo giyo mumugye gwa Yerusaremu.
Ne eraabhe erirorekana kubha, enye woosi nireenderwa kugya, niragya hamwe nabho.
Obhuzaabhi bhwa Pauro bhwo okuhika Koriinto
Niraaza kweemwe eyo, hano nikurwa mukyaaro kya Makedonia, kwo okubha ndeenda hiinga nihitire mukyaaro kya Makedonia.
Hano niraaze, hamwe niriikara neemwe kwiibhaga iguhi, kasi kwe eriibhaga ryoosi rye embeho, okubha munisakirye okugeenderera no orugeendo rwaane rwo okugya hohoosi hano nikweenda kugya.
Nitaseegiri kurorana neemwe bhoono no okuhita ego. Niriisiga kwiikara kweemwe kwiibhaga, eraabhe Omukuru araaniikirirye.
Nawe bhoono nirasaaga mumugye gwa Efeso, tee orusiku rwe enyaangi ya Pentekositi ruhike.
Nirakora ego, kwo okubha Taatabhugya aniiguriiri enzira yo okukora emirimo mikuru mumugye guno, yiingabha bhariho abhaatu bhaaru bhano bhakunirekya.
Hano Timoteo akuuza kweemwe, mumusuungʼaane bhuzomu, okubha yiikare okutama kubha ne ehaho, kwo okubha ewe arakora emirimo gyo Omukuru kyeego enye.
Omuutu wowoosi atamuzeera, nawe mumusakirye ageende kwo omureembe, okubha anagye kukyoora kweenye, kwo okubha enye niramuganya hamwe na abhiikirirya abharikyeetu.

Bhoono, iguru yo omwiikirirya omurikyeetu Apooro, nimwiisasaamiri bhukongʼu kubha, yiize oweenyu eyo, hamwe na abhiikirirya abhaandi. Nawe ewe ateendiri kuuza bhoono. Araaza eriibhaga rino akubhona omweeya.
Amangʼana go okuraga
Muteengeeze, mugumire mubhwiikirirya, kweeki mubhe abhakaari na bha amanaga.
Amangʼana geenyu goosi mubhe murakora kwo obhuseegi.

Abhahiiri bhaane, mumenyiri kubha Sitefana hamwe na abhaatu bha yiika waaye, nibho bhaataangiri okumwiikirirya Yeesu Krisito mumugye gwa Akaaya, nabho bhiiruusirye okubhasakirya abhahoreeru. Kweego, nirabhiisasaama,
mubhe murabhiigwa abhaatu kya bhayo, na abhaandi bhoosi bhano bhakukora emirimo giyo hamwe nabho kwo omukya.
Nirazomererwa bhukongʼu hano Sitefana, Foritunato na Akaiko, bhakaaza hano. Ebho bhakaaniha gano niasuuhiirwe kwe ekigirirye kye emwe okutama kubhaho hano.
Bhasaambaarukirye ekoro yaane, ne eziikoro zyeenyu. Kweego, mubhamenye kisi abhaatu kya bhano.

Abhaatu bha mumakanisa mukyaaro kya Asia, bharabhakeerya. Akiira na mukaaye Prisika, hamwe na abhiikirirya bhano bhakwiikumania yiika waabhu, bharabhakeerya bhukongʼu kwo okugwaatana no Omukuru Yeesu.
Abhiikirirya bhoosi bha hano, bharabhakeerya. Mubhakeerye abhiikirirya bhoosi kwo obhuseegi bhwa Krisito.
Enye Pauro nirakaama obhukeerya bhuno kwo okubhoko kwaane omweene.
Omuutu wowoosi wuno atakumuseega Omukuru Yeesu, yiihiimwe. Nawuuze Omukuru weetu!
Orubhaango rwo Omukuru Yeesu rubhe neemwe.
Nirabhaseega emwe mwoosi, kwo okugwaatana na Krisito Yeesu.
